title: 招聘动态：Scopely、Supercell、Google、Roblox、Tripledot 等公司人事变动
content:
Jobs digest: moves and promotions at Scopely, Supercell, Google, Roblox, Tripledot and more – Mobilegamer.biz

Scopely
:
Hamed Safaei
is a new senior game engineer on Monopoly Go, relocating to Seville after time in Iran’s games industry, including Karizma Game Studio and Medrick FZE.
Luca Colonnelli
has started in Barcelona as a product manager on Scopely’s MBA product leadership rotational programme, following a stint at Dream One Project.
Supercell
:
Antoine Madre
has moved into a game lead role at Supercell after more than two years as product lead on mo.co, which
recently went back into beta
. He previously served as general manager at Voodoo.
Patrick Williams
has joined as global communications strategist after more than four years at agency The Romans, having worked closely with Supercell for the past few years.
Nafees Ahsan
starts as a game researcher intern after a year at Nokia.
Scopely’s Safaei and Colonnelli, Supercell’s Madre, Williams and Ahsan.
Google
:
Apollo Lee
has traded Amazon, where he spent five and a half years, for the role of strategy and operations lead for Google Play Games.
Louis Evans
has stepped up to team lead for apps and gaming publisher solutions engineering after leading the AdMob mediation tests and migrations team.
Roblox
:
Derek Yang
has made the move from Discord, where he was group product manager, to director of product management at Roblox.
Tripledot
:
Kerim Figanioglu
is Tripledot Studios’ new senior product manager, having previously been product lead at Ruby Games Studio.
Google’s Lee and Evans, Roblox’s Yang, Tripledot’s Figanioglu and Miniclip’s Demirel.
Miniclip
:
Ozan Demirel
has moved from TapNation to Miniclip, where he is now a senior game designer.
Playtika
:
Jess Seaton
joins as retention manager with eight years of games industry experience, most recently as a lifecycle marketing specialist at Zynga.
BoomBit
:
Mac Byczynski
is BoomBit’s new VP of business development and global partnerships, bringing 16 years of mobile games experience to the role. He keeps his position at AppLifters.
Neon
:
Miikka Lindgren
has swapped Sandsoft Games for San Francisco-based D2C vendor Neon, where he is VP of strategic partnerships.
Playtika’s Seaton, BoomBit’s Byczynski, Neon’s Lindgren, Trailmix’s Cranston and Grand’s Ersavaş.
Trailmix Games
:
Johanna Cranston
is Trailmix’s new senior game artist, following time as a 2D artist at Supersolid.
Grand Games
:
Ayşe Ersavaş
has stepped up from an internship at Good Job Games to product specialist at Grand Games, while studying industrial engineering at Boğaziçi University.
